items.title: Build host handoff preflight pack including session_brief, memory preflight, stories/checklists, gap, and stale-validation signals
items.context: Add a host-facing projection consumed by handoff routes so every host can load fresh canonical facts before action.
items.userSees: ✓ CHK-001 complete: host handoff preflight payload now includes session, memory, story, gap, and learning-stale signals.

happy.desc: hosting `lattice handoff_create` now returns preflight manifest including session_brief + devMemory + active story + gap + learning signals

edge.desc: when one input call fails, preflight summary still includes a deterministic stale verdict and winSignal when possible

adversarial.desc: host handoff is called with missing or stale artifacts and does not claim pending work without evidence

items.title: Add plan supersession detection and completed-story references
items.context: Detect status completed/superseded, supersededBy, completedByStory, completionCommit from planning artifacts and expose them in handoff facts.
items.userSees: ✓ CHK-002 complete: supersession detection is exposed in handoff pack for completed/superseded plans.

happy.desc: completed doc markers in plan artifacts are parsed into host handoff preflight metadata

edge.desc: docs with historical/superseded markers are carried through but not treated as primary proof

adversarial.desc: superseded doc chains with missing commit references are flagged as uncertain instead of trusted

items.title: Reject risky handoff claims without required evidence state
items.context: Add a handoff precheck gate for stale-doc and evidence freshness before resume/accept, and return explicit stale summary.
items.userSees: ✓ CHK-003 complete: handoff resume/accept returns explicit stale-doc evidence and blocks unsupported pending claims.

happy.desc: resume requires evidence-backed story status before declaring item incomplete

edge.desc: when evidence is missing, preflight verdict is uncertain and user is asked to revalidate

adversarial.desc: host does not block when memory suggests done but no authoritative DONE proof exists

items.title: Expose preflight payloads in host status/probe outputs and add regression tests
items.context: Keep host handoff deterministic and auditable for 3x2/2-host workflows with machine-readable fact snapshots.
items.userSees: ✓ CHK-004 complete: host status/probe shows preflight summaries and tests cover manifest fields.

happy.desc: host status/probe returns preflightManifest keys including winSignal and verdict

edge.desc: host status output is stable when preflight artifacts are incomplete

adversarial.desc: CLAUDE/Antigravity path includes same manifest fields and evidence tags
